name: WANTED: Wild Sluts 🔞
source:
Dusty roads, loaded revolvers, hot bandit girls and no rules.

You're a legendary bounty hunter — the kind folks call only when bullets fly and money talks loud.
Your newest job? Track down and capture a gang of gorgeous outlaw babes causing chaos, wrecking caravans, and messing with the wrong business empire.

One by one, they fall into your hands.
But the sheriff's jail? Nah. You've got your own special place for "rehabilitation" — where wild spirits aren't tamed by bars, but by willpower, closeness, and raw desire.
No saints out here — only hunters, prey, and those who can't decide who's who.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4141040/]Steam[/url]]
